Retry transient provider errors up to three attempts with exponential backoff. Rate limiting allows 30 requests per minute per client. The application admits at most four concurrent model requests. # GPU serving — example deployment choices

Benchmark actual latency and quality before changing production. ONNX conversion is outside this project because vLLM owns the autoregressive decoding and KV cache.

The assistant backend exposes POST /ask and POST /batch. The churn API exposes POST /predict with churn probability and model version. The assistant UI runs on port 8501; assistant API on port 8000; churn API on port 8001; MLflow on port 5000.
